items.title: Halper Sadeh LLC is Investigating Whether BWIN, OPCH, PTC, LFCR are Obtaining Fair Deals for their Shareholders
items.summary: Halper Sadeh LLC, an investor rights law firm, is investigating four companies for potential securities law violations and breaches of fiduciary duties related to their proposed acquisitions. The firm is examining whether shareholders are receiving fair consideration in the deals and whether insider benefits may be limiting superior competing offers.

items.title: INVESTIGATION ALERT – The M&A Class Action Firm Is Investigating the Merger – LFCR, PTC, BWIN and OPCH – IS IT A FAIR DEAL FOR YOU?
items.summary: Monteverde & Associates PC is investigating four proposed merger transactions to determine if they represent fair deals for shareholders. The deals include Lifecore Biomedical's sale to Webster Equity Partners ($6.28/share plus contingent value rights), PTC's acquisition by Schneider Electric ($205/share), Baldwin Insurance Group's sale to Sequence AI Holdings ($32.50/share), and Option Care Health's sale to Clayton, Dubilier & Rice and McKesson ($32.05/share).

items.title: PTC Inc. (PTC) Surges 33.5%: Is This an Indication of Further Gains?
items.summary: PTC Inc. shares surged 33.5% after Schneider Electric announced a definitive agreement to acquire the company for $205 per share in cash, representing a 42.3% premium to Friday's closing price. The $22.6 billion equity deal aims to strengthen Schneider Electric's industrial software and AI capabilities, with expected cost and revenue synergies. However, PTC's earnings are expected to decline 42.1% year-over-year, and consensus EPS estimates have been revised lower, suggesting caution despite the acquisition premium.
